sources.title: GitHub - krishnakg12/fraud-detection-ml-system
sources.snippet: Fraud detection in financial systems presents three major challenges: Extreme class imbalance (~0.13% fraud rate) Real-time inference constraints (<50 ms latency) Asymmetric cost of errors (false negatives far more expensive than false positives) This work focuses on designing a system that balances detection performance with operational and economic constraints.
